messages.subject: GCC ESG & Sustainability Executive | Government Relations, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Simon,

Your work leading Sustainable Recruitment Solutions in Dubai, with a specialist focus on ESG, sustainability and environmental leadership across the Middle East, makes this a deliberate introduction.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My leadership portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications within a major gold-mining operation.

My strongest fit is in Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where responsible development, institutional credibility, regulatory discipline and stakeholder execution must operate together. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market and the UAE is second, with broader GCC mobility.

My current executive CV is attached for consideration for suitable mandates across ESG and Sustainability, Government Relations, External and Corporate Affairs, Stakeholder Relations, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership.

Best regards,

Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
